name: amarr
description: This connector allows using aMule as a download client for starr apps. It works by emulating a torrent client, so your starr apps will manage your downloads as if they were torrents.

paths.name: Complete Downloads
paths.description: Try to match this location with the download location in your starr apps.

ports.name: DL Client Port
ports.description: Amarr pretends to be qbittorent, this is the port you can use to set it up.

variables.name: FINISHED_FOLDER
variables.description: Make sure to match the container path of the Complete Downloads folder. This is what the client reports back to the starr apps as completed folder.

variables.name: AMULE_HOST
variables.description: The network address for your amule client, or the name of the container when on a shared network.
